title: बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको सन्दर्भमा निजी विद्यालयका कक्षामा भाषा प्रयोगको अवस्था {The state of language use in private school classrooms in the context of multilingual education}
nepali: पहिलो वा मातृभाषामा आधारभूत ज्ञान लिएर प्रारम्भिक कक्षामा प्रवेश गरेका बालबालिकामा बहुभाषिक क्षमताको विकासगरी बहुभाषिक विश्वमा समायोजन हुन योग्य बनाउन बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको अवधारणा विकसित भएको देखिन्छ । विश्वभरिएकैपटक प्रारम्भ भई सबैलाई गुणात्मक शिक्षा दिने उद्देश्य रहेको बहुभाषिक शिक्षा पद्धतिमा शिक्षण सिकाइका क्रममादुई वा सोभन्दा बढी भाषालाई माध्यम बनाउनु आवश्यक हुन्छ । यसै सन्दर्भमा बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको सापेक्षतामा निजीविद्यालयका प्रारम्भिक कक्षामा भाषा प्रयोगको अवस्था अध्ययन गर्ने उद्देश्य प्रस्तुत लेखको रहेको छ । गुणात्मक प्रकृतिकोयस लेखमा घटना अध्ययन विधिको प्रयोग गरी अवलोकन र अन्तर्वार्ताका आधारमा तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुतअध्ययनले शिक्षण सिकाइका क्रममा बहुभाषाको प्रयोगले सबै भाषाका सिकारूलाई लाभ हुने हुँदा प्रारम्भिक कक्षादेखि नैबहुभाषा माध्यम अपनाइने बहुभाषिक शिक्षा पद्धति प्रभावकारी हुने उल्लेख गरेको छ । बहुभाषिक शिक्षाका लागि प्रतिबद्धताजनाएको नेपालले शिक्षण सिकाइका क्रममा बहुभाषिक कक्षाका लागि तय गरेका माध्यम भाषाका नीतिगत व्यवस्था एवम्सुझाव र निजी विद्यालयका कक्षामा प्रयोग गरिएको अङ्ग्रेजी मात्र माध्यम एकल भाषिक पद्धतिमा आधारित देखिन्छन् ।प्रस्तुत लेखमा राज्यले बहुभाषिक शिक्षाका लागि वैज्ञानिक आधारमा व्यावहारिक नीति र मोडल तय गरी निजी विद्यालयलाईस्पष्ट मार्गदर्शन गर्न नसकेको अवस्थामा बहुभाषिक समुदायमा अवस्थित निजी विद्यालयले समुदाय तथा अभिभावककोमनोविज्ञान, भाषा बजार, विश्वव्यापी आवश्यकता र सिकाइ सहजतालाई केन्द्रमा राखी प्रारम्भिक उर्वरयोग्य उमेरदेखिनै बहुभाषालाई शिक्षण सिकाइको माध्यम बनाउने रणनीतिले बहुभाषिक कक्षामा बहुभाषिक शिक्षाको आधार निर्माण गर्नेकुरालाई निष्कर्षका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । {The concept of multilingual education seems to have been developed to enable children entering primary school with basic knowledge in first or mother tongue to be able to integrate into the multilingual world by developing their multilingual ability. The multilingual education system, which aims to provide quality education to all, once started all over the world, requires the use of two or more languages ​​as a medium of instruction. In this context, the purpose of this article is to study the use of language in the elementary class of private schools in relation to multilingual education. The qualitative nature of the article is based on observations and interviews using incident study methods. The present study has mentioned that the use of multilingual in the process of teaching and learning will benefit the learners of all languages, so the multilingual education system adopted from the elementary class through multilingual medium will be effective. Nepal, which is committed to multilingual education, seems to be based on a single language system based on the policy provisions and recommendations of the medium language for multilingual classes in the course of teaching and learning and the English medium used in private school classrooms. In the present article, while the state has not been able to guide private schools in setting practical policies and models for multilingual education on a scientific basis, private schools in multilingual communities have focused on community and parental psychology, language market, global needs and learning facilitation. Conclusions have been presented to build the foundation of multilingual education.}
american_english: The concept of multilingual education appears to have developed in order to build multilingual capacity in children entering early grades with foundational knowledge in their first or native language and make them fit to adapt to a multilingual world. In the multilingual education system, which originated simultaneously across the globe with the objective of providing quality education to all, it is essential to make two or more languages the medium of instruction during teaching and learning. In this context, the objective of the present article is to study the status of language use in early grades of private schools relative to multilingual education. In this qualitative article, data has been collected based on observations and interviews using the case study method. The present study notes that because utilizing multiple languages during teaching and learning benefits learners of all languages, a multilingual education system that adopts a multilingual medium right from early grades will be effective. While Nepal has committed to multilingual education, the policy provisions and recommendations formulated for the medium of instruction in multilingual classrooms during teaching and learning, as well as the English-only medium used in private school classrooms, appear to be based on a monolingual approach. In the present article, in circumstances where the state has been unable to provide clear guidance to private schools by establishing practical policies and models on a scientific basis for multilingual education, the conclusion is presented that a strategy whereby private schools located in multilingual communities make multiple languages the medium of teaching and learning right from early fertile developmental ages—placing community and parental psychology, the linguistic market, global demands, and learning ease at the center—builds the foundation for multilingual education in multilingual classrooms.
